title: Make the CSV line parser RFC 4180 compatible
instruction: parseCsvLine(line) in src/csv.mjs splits a single CSV record into fields. Make it follow RFC 4180 for one record: fields are separated by ','; a field may be enclosed in double quotes; inside a quoted field ',' is literal and '""' means one '"'; empty fields are preserved (',,' gives an empty field, a trailing ',' gives a trailing empty field). An unterminated quoted field throws SyntaxError. Unquoted fields are returned unchanged (no trimming).

acceptanceCriteria: empty and trailing empty fields preserved
